name.zh: 恶魔学识 Beta 开荒

summary.zh: 所有点数都投给恶魔：宠物伤害提高 10%、生命与法力提高 15%，你的法术伤害还会治疗它。
summary.en: Every point goes into the demon: 10% more pet damage, 15% more pet health and Mana, and your spell damage healing it.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，靠虚空行者或小鬼在前面顶着练级
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, levelling behind a Voidwalker or Imp

pros.zh: 邪恶强化让小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔与地狱猎犬的伤害统一提高 10%，换宠物时点数依然有效。
pros.en: Unholy Power adds 10% damage to your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus and Felhunter alike, so the points stay useful as you change demons.

pros.zh: 邪能活力让宠物的最大生命与法力提高 15%，同时提高你自己的最大法力。
pros.en: Fel Vitality adds 15% to your pet's maximum health and Mana and raises your own maximum Mana.

pros.zh: 恶魔能量让你造成的法术伤害有 15% 治疗宠物，并把生命分流获得的法力同步给它，虚空行者因此能一直扛住。
pros.en: Demonic Energies heals your pet for 15% of all the spell damage you deal and shares your Life Tap Mana with it, which is what keeps a Voidwalker tanking indefinitely.

pros.zh: 召唤大师是可调整的 1 点；再加 1 点可以进一步缩短召唤时间与法力消耗。
pros.en: Master Summoner holds the flexible point; a second point there takes more time and Mana off every summon.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
